title: Fix the Typo
description: Play sharp-eyed proofreader across witty essays, signs, and notes—spot sneaky homophone typos and swap in the right Chinese characters.
controls: Scan the text passage and tap every misspelled character to mark and fix all typos in the level.

zh-CN.title: 纠正错别字
zh-CN.description: 寓教于乐爆款文字游戏纠正错别字：化身毒舌语文老师批改奇葩作文与招牌，一眼揪出隐藏错别字超有成就感！
zh-CN.controls: 仔细阅读屏幕中的趣味文案，点击找出并纠正全部隐藏的错别字即可满分过关。
